name: Bermuda
summary_text: Bermuda: own legal system; marriage equality since 2017; church-going conservative society but functioning protections. Scored as a dependent jurisdiction: the parent framework governs what a visitor encounters, plus local society and enforcement. Score re-anchored 2026-09-24: United Kingdom (0.48) plus a local delta of +0.04. This jurisdiction was not covered by the dedicated state/province research passes.

sources.title: Judge rules Scottish guidance for housing trans prisoners is unlawful - BBC News
sources.claim_summary: NOTE: This BBC article is about Scotland's prison policy for trans prisoners (June 2026 ruling), not Bermuda; included as UK-context material (Bermuda is a British Overseas Territory).

sources.title: Suicide risk if trans prisoners are put in jails based on sex at birth, court told - BBC News
sources.claim_summary: NOTE: This BBC article is about the same Scottish prison-housing litigation (Feb 2026), not Bermuda; included as UK-context material only.

sources.title: Governor Gives Assent: Domestic Partnerships - Bernews
sources.claim_summary: Bernews (Feb 2018): Bermuda's Governor gave assent to the Domestic Partnership Act 2017, replacing same-sex marriage with domestic partnerships for both same-sex and heterosexual couples - the reversal that made Bermuda the first jurisdiction to revoke marriage equality.

sources.title: Rosie's gay cruise is backed by Bermuda's leader | PinkNews
sources.claim_summary: PinkNews (April 2007): Bermuda's Premier Ewart Brown defended allowing Rosie O'Donnell's gay family cruise to dock against church objections ('If we discriminate against a cruise ship, then we would have to send a homosexual detection unit to the airport') - documents tourism-related LGBT friction.

sources.title: Bermuda Senate approves bill prohibiting discrimination against gays - LGBTQ Nation
sources.claim_summary: LGBTQ Nation/AP (July 2013): Bermuda's Senate passed the Human Rights Amendment Act outlawing discrimination on grounds of sexual orientation (also banning age discrimination); same-sex marriage not then permitted.

sources.title: Stubbs' gay sex bill wins MP's support - The Royal Gazette | Bermuda News, Business, Sports, Events, & Community |
sources.claim_summary: Royal Gazette (May 1994): Bermuda's House of Assembly voted 22-16 to decriminalise sex between adult males, removing two Criminal Code sections - historical legal context.
